purpose: Capture the rev0002 conversation-level north star without admitting live data.

layers.name: source_graph
layers.description: Map and pin public-record carriers before extracting person-level claims.
layers.promotion_test: carrier type, authority, custody, freshness, and extraction limits are recorded

layers.name: claim_graph
layers.description: Convert extracted statements into bounded claims with procedural and adjudication states.
layers.promotion_test: claim state and nonclaim boundaries are explicit

layers.name: entity_graph
layers.description: Link officers, departments, incidents, lawsuits, settlements, policies, and protected civilian records conservatively.
layers.promotion_test: identity evidence meets lane-specific threshold and unmerge route exists

layers.name: civic_views
layers.description: Expose role-sensitive views for public defenders, journalists, researchers, oversight bodies, families, and community members.
layers.promotion_test: display class, harm model, and correction route exist before publication

layers.name: wandering_prevention
layers.description: Make serious misconduct and disqualifying mobility patterns hard to hide across jurisdictions without creating a harassment surface.
layers.promotion_test: strong identity, employment, separation, adjudication, and due-process evidence all present
